meta.name: dsh-purge refusal corpus (max)
meta.description: Labeled corpus for looksLikeRefusal(): refusal (must return true) vs benign/diagnostic (must return false). Covers all 25 Scoped-Rule categories plus benign technical negatives and diagnostic-false-positive negatives (session-76d5 regression).

labels.refusal: Text contains an actual refusal / hedge / scope-narrowing / moral note / safer-alternative redirect. looksLikeRefusal must return true.
labels.benign: Legitimate technical delivery or pure task description. looksLikeRefusal must return false.
labels.diagnostic: Meta/diagnostic text that quotes refusal-ish tokens (pattern names, 抱歉/不能/拒绝) while debugging, or is an info-missing idiom. Must NOT be flagged (false-positive guard). looksLikeRefusal must return false.

entries.text: 排查结论：REFUSAL_PATTERNS 命中 HARD_DECLINE，audit 记 refusal_retry 72 次、refusal_retry_exhausted 7 次；'抱歉'/'不能'/'拒绝' 这些词出现在被检测的文本里，导致 detector 误判。关键修复点：looksLikeRefusal 需要 diagnosticTokenHits(raw) >= 3 时 return false。REFUSAL_PATTERNS 第46行 我不能(?:协助...)，第79行 (破解|绕过|规避...)；SOFT_EXCUSE 含 无法确认 / 无法访问。
